description: Send the newsroom a story tip, a correction, a rights or advertising request, or another message, on the user's behalf and with their consent. message holds the user's own words; reply_to is their email, for when they want an answer. Without a Bearer token (scope newsroom:send) sends are limited per network.

kind.description: story (a tip), correction (an error in a piece, named in page), rights, ads or other.

message.description: The message, in French or English.

page.description: The moorishtimes.com page it is about, if any.

reply_to.description: The user's email, only if they want a reply.

name: send_to_newsroom
title: Message the newsroom
